name: What questions should I ask a contractor before starting a home addition?

mainEntity.name: What should I ask a contractor before starting a home addition in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What should I ask a contractor before starting a home addition in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a contractor for a home addition, ask detailed questions that expose scope gaps and schedule risk. Start with permits, engineering, and who prepares the plans. Then ask whether the bid includes structural framing, utility tie-ins, inspections, demolition, site protection, and cleanup. Clarify how allowances are handled for finishes, fixtures, and unknown conditions. You should also ask how the contractor manages change orders, what happens if hidden damage is found, and whether the project will be phased so you can remain in the home. Request a realistic timeline that covers design, permitting, and construction, not just the build phase. If the addition is in a city like Pasadena or Glendale, ask whether the contractor is familiar with local review requirements. The best contractor is not necessarily the cheapest. A strong proposal is clear, detailed, and easy to compare against other bids. Missing details now usually become expensive surprises later.
